final: WITH j AS (SELECT ab.translink AS translink, t.tradekind AS tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref), c AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tradekind, translink), s AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_margin FROM a WHERE share >= avg_share GROUP BY tradekind
